action.objective: Capture the b4 pawn, keep the extra rook and push the a- and e-pawns.
action.rationale: Bxb4 is the only commit_ready move: exact +835 at depth 3, safety complete (no mate-in-one), tactical_refutation and checking-chain not_found, and Black has no immediate capture on b4. It wins a pawn, frees the a4 rook for a7/a8 pressure, and keeps the d5/e6 passed pawns supported. Alternatives are only upper bounds, so their real scores could be worse. Committing the verified capture. Black's likely reply Kf7/Ke8 lets Ra7 or e7 gain further ground.
